name: zt-figure-explain
description: Explain the figures of Scholar Archive documents: a DeepSeek agent looks at each image and writes what it shows, and the explanation is saved beside the image in the Scholar Archive (docs/figure-explanation-design.md). It reads no OCR text, writes no Card and needs no digest staging. A rerun redoes nothing: only images with no explanation for their current bytes get a job.
whenToUse: Backfill the figure explanations of books already digested, or explain the figures of any archived Markdown. args: {fileIds: [the Markdown file ids], root?: the existing folder to work under}. The digests run the same module by themselves before Prepare.

preflight.P1: Goal and result: every figure of the named Markdown documents has an explanation beside its image in the Scholar Archive. The result is the module's counts.
preflight.P2: Inputs: fileIds (Markdown file ids), root (an existing folder).
preflight.P3: Units of work: one job per four images of a document; the archive's explanation files are the record of what is done, so there is no ledger.
preflight.P4: Roles: manager = Haiku, runs the drive jobs and the reader jobs; DeepSeek writes the text; zt-digest checks and saves it.
preflight.P5: Stage graph: args gate, then explain.
preflight.P7: Checks: explain-check is every job's SELF-CHECK and the finish's gate (names, kinds, length, Chinese, no OCR copy); the archive checks each explanation against the image's bytes.
preflight.P8: Failure policy: images still open after two rounds fail the stage with explanations_open; saved explanations stay, and a rerun takes only the open ones.

manager.description: Haiku: runs the DeepSeek drive and reader jobs; it runs no command of its own

fileIds.description: the Markdown file ids of the documents, e.g. [95, 1283]

root.description: an existing folder; the pass works in its _figure-explain folder

checks.message: args.fileIds must name at least one Markdown file id

stages.title: Explain
stages.detail: one start, one queue of managers, one finish
